data.title: Order to stop holiday rentals of your flat
data.summary: The Hamburg district office (Bezirksamt Beispielbüttel, housing protection department) ordered you on 2 April 2026 to stop renting your flat at Grindelhof 21 to holiday guests. A coercive fine (Zwangsgeld) may be set if you don't comply.
data.explanation: The authority says you have offered the flat to holiday guests by the day since January 2026 without the required permit for using housing for other purposes (Zweckentfremdung). You must end the short-term rentals and use or let the flat for permanent living. If you don't, a coercive fine may be set. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch); the app shows the deadline. It must be received by the office in writing, electronically with a qualified signature, or recorded in person. Consider getting legal advice.

items.title: Object to the order (optional)

date.text: spätestens einen Monat nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids

items.action: If you disagree, file an objection (Widerspruch) so that it is received by Bezirksamt Beispielbüttel, Grindelberg 62, 20144 Hamburg, in writing, electronically with a qualified signature, or recorded in person.
items.consequence: After the deadline the order becomes final and can no longer be challenged.
items.quote: Ihr Widerspruch muss spätestens einen Monat nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids beim Bezirksamt Beispielbüttel, Grindelberg 62, 20144 Hamburg, eingehen – schriftlich, elektronisch mit qualifizierter Signatur oder zur Niederschrift.

items.title: Stop short-term holiday rentals

date.text: Wir geben Ihnen daher auf, die Vermietung an wechselnde Gäste zu beenden

items.action: End the rental to changing guests and use or let the flat for permanent living.
items.consequence: A coercive fine (Zwangsgeld) may be set.
items.quote: Kommen Sie dieser Anordnung nicht nach, kann ein Zwangsgeld festgesetzt werden.
